contents: Shared structures, fixed addresses and register use; structure layouts are defined in the board driver pvr_rogue_fwif*.h and pvr_rogue_mips.h

virtual_memory_map.contents: boot and NMI code (boot remap of physical 0x1fc00000)
boot data: 64-byte rogue_mipsfw_boot_data at 0; NMI shared data from 0x100; exception scratch near 0x800
main heap: code, private data at 0xc0032000, host firmware objects
runtime mappings written by the firmware into its page table (bytes 0x3b40.. of the table)
second view of the register bank, most stores (meaning inferred)

values.3: POW_IDLE (firmware writes it at 0xc000ad1c, then raises the host interrupt)

host_interrupt.status: RGX_CR_MIPS_WRAPPER_IRQ_STATUS 0x8a8 bit 0, written by the firmware
